source: Dr Lam's diagnosis was “sprain injury to the neck”.
injuries.icd_description: Strain or sprain of cervical spine

injuries.description: cervical injury to C4/5 level with compression of cervical spinal cord and myelomalacia causing mild T2 signal changes
source: the trauma of the Accident caused cervical injury to C4/5 level with compression of cervical spinal cord and myelomalacia causing mild T2 signal changes.
injuries.icd_description: Other incomplete cord syndrome of cervical spinal cord

injuries.description: degenerative changes in the lumbar spine with slight decrease in lumbar lordosis
source: Degenerative changes were noted in the lumbar spine with slight decrease in lumbar lordosis.
injuries.icd_description: Injuries to the abdomen, lower back, lumbar spine or pelvis

injuries.description: discectomy and anterior spinal fusion (ASF) at C5/6 performed in 1992 (post-operative status)
source: discectomy and ASF were performed by a team of surgeons including Dr Y F Ho. The diagnosis was “cervical PID C5/6 with myelopathy”.
injuries.icd_description: Other incomplete cord syndrome of cervical spinal cord

manifestations.description: pain over his right neck and right shoulder
numbness and occasional cramps of the right lower limb; frequent tripping of right foot (drop-foot)
reduction in the range of motion of the neck
difficulty in climbing and descending stairs and diminished balancing ability

treatments_received: hospitalisation (admitted to PWH AED and ward care)

losses.description: Pain, suffering and loss of amenities
Difficulty walking, climbing and descending stairs, diminished balancing ability and limited movement of limbs
